title: Stained Glass Designs: Coloring Book for Adults and Teens, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Beautiful Window Pattern Illustrations Featuring Flowers, Animals, and Geometric Mosaic Art for Relaxation
description:
Color the radiant beauty of stained glass windows with bold lines and stunning patterns.


This beautiful coloring book brings the timeless art of stained glass to your fingertips. Each page features a gorgeous stained glass window design — from elegant floral panels and graceful animal motifs to intricate geometric mosaics and nature-inspired compositions. The bold lead lines and clearly defined sections make every design satisfying and easy to color, while the variety of subjects keeps each page fresh and exciting.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique stained glass window designs with bold, easy-to-color outlines
• Floral panels, animal motifs, geometric patterns, and nature scenes
• Art Nouveau, Gothic, and contemporary stained glass styles
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch pages for comfortable coloring
• Perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and creative focus with structured patterns
• A stunning gift for art lovers and craft enthusiasts
• Meditative coloring with clear, defined sections
• All skill levels — beginners to experienced colorists

Pick up your brightest colors and let these windows glow.
Every page is a masterpiece of light and color waiting for you.
